title: At this lake, the dawn chair is yours if you can ride it alone all week
description:
I booked the first chair up the lake chairlift every dawn for a week, both seats, so I could watch the sunrise from the ridge on my own. Bo, who runs the bottom station, bet me I couldn't do it. The old couple at the gate rope just watched the chairs go.

Every morning a rider in a faded orange cagoule came down the line by itself, a little nearer my chair each time. Its head was square, and its face was always turned toward me.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: How many dawns would you have lasted riding up alone?
